neighbours.label: the word right after a count numeral in a quantity phrase ('4 out of 5', '5 x 10', '9 blood samples', '3 per cent'), as against the same words with no count before them
fire: In the poll, roughly 7 out of 10 parents said they wanted longer school days.
The report noted that 3 out of 4 bridges in the county needed repairs.
Its estimated mass is about 6 x 1024 kilograms, close to that of Earth.
Of the 150 volunteers, 12 tissue samples showed signs of infection.
Unemployment in the city fell by 2 per cent over the summer months.
The inspectors found that 9 out of 12 restaurants broke the hygiene rules.
From the 80 hives checked, 14 honey samples contained traces of pesticide.
Researchers say that 2 out of 3 adults sleep less than they should.
quiet: In the poll, most parents said they wanted longer school days.
The report noted that many bridges in the county needed repairs.
Its estimated mass is close to that of Earth, the astronomers said.
Among the volunteers, some tissue samples showed signs of infection.
Unemployment in the city fell slightly over the summer months.
The inspectors found that several restaurants broke the hygiene rules.
From the hives they checked, the honey samples contained traces of pesticide.
Researchers say that most adults sleep less than they should.

predictions: fire 0.3-0.8 on ' out', ' x', ' per' or the counted noun right after a numeral; the same words without a preceding count below 0.1
